Quote verbatim. Article says he 'voiced concerns not only about federal decisions to expand the development of data centers, but also about federal use of AI in surveillance.'

score_objections.objection: Both ai_risk sources are Oversight Committee letters about government use of AI cameras (D.C. DOB) and OpenAI nonprofit-fund/conflict-of-interest questions. Neither addresses rules for AI models or the AI industry; the item claims themselves concede this ('rather than an industry rule', 'not model safety'). Evidence is too thin to place him at -1 Targeted guardrails on AI risk.
